title: SaaS Analytics · Risograph Broadsheet
summary: A warm anti-corporate risograph-printed broadsheet for the Aurora product-analytics dashboard: SVG halftone dot screens encode plan share by density and two spot colors (fluorescent red and federal blue) deliberately misregister with mix-blend-mode multiply overprint so the clash reads as a physical print. Editorial serif italic display over tiny mono captions, off-grid broadsheet columns with an intentional 3° skew on decorative blocks.
